'''2009 Bespin Regionals Jared Hagen DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jared Hagen]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' No Han For You
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
